title: Redirected action correspondence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k$ work tapes, let $b$ be a Boolean value, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. For any action $a$ of $M$ and $c$, applying the corresponding redirected action to the redirected configuration of $c$ gives the redirected configuration of the result of applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite machine $M$ over Booleans and its number $k$ of work tapes
